```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "\\linewidth"
)

# Required packages
packages <- c(
  # Data preparation and reporting
  "tidyverse",
  "here",
  "knitr",

  # Bayesian inference with Stan
  "cmdstanr",
  "posterior",

  # Posterior analysis and visualization
  "bayesplot",
  "tidybayes"
)

# Check whether all required packages are installed
missing_packages <- packages[
  !packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Please install them before running this document."
  )
}

# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(knitr)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
library(tidybayes)
```
